premise: The base settles for the night: tools away, the Milky Way comes out, tiny lights drift overhead, the Earth glows, and one by one everyone closes their eyes.
inspiration: Eugene Field's 'Wynken, Blynken, and Nod' (sailing off to sleep among the stars), turned: from the Moon, the stars are right there, and they don't even blink.

en-US.title: Lullaby for the Base
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall 16s} [softly] {all:pulse} Goodnight, Moon Base. {all:face happy} The work is done. {all:hop} The tools are put away, and the boots are lined up in a row. {canvas:milkyway 16s} Overhead, the Milky Way comes out: {all:glow} a river of stars, with nothing to sail on it but dreams. [whispers] {all:pulse 0.4} Goodnight, plain. Goodnight, crater. Goodnight, landing pad and tall radio mast. {canvas:satellites 16s} {all:sparkle 0.4} Tiny lights glide across the sky, far, far above, like little boats. {all:hearts} Goodnight, Earth, glowing blue over the ridge: somebody down there is falling asleep too. [yawns] {all:wobble 0.3} The base hums softly, like a purring cat. {all:face sleeping} One by one, everyone closes their eyes. [softly] {all:glow 0.3} The stars keep watch. They don't even blink. Goodnight, Moon Base. Goodnight.

es-ES.title: Nana para la base
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall 16s} [softly] {all:pulse} Buenas noches, Base Lunar. {all:face happy} El trabajo está hecho. {all:hop} Las herramientas, recogidas, y las botas, en fila. {canvas:milkyway 16s} Allá arriba sale la Vía Láctea: {all:glow} un río de estrellas por el que solo navegan los sueños. [whispers] {all:pulse 0.4} Buenas noches, llanura. Buenas noches, cráter. Buenas noches, plataforma y mástil de la antena. {canvas:satellites 16s} {all:sparkle 0.4} Unas lucecitas cruzan el cielo, muy, muy arriba, como barquitas. {all:hearts} Buenas noches, Tierra, que brillas azul sobre la cordillera: allí abajo también hay alguien quedándose dormido. [yawns] {all:wobble 0.3} La base ronronea bajito, como un gato. {all:face sleeping} Uno a uno, todos cierran los ojos. [softly] {all:glow 0.3} Las estrellas vigilan. Ni siquiera parpadean. Buenas noches, Base Lunar. Buenas noches.
